answer: One defense is pricing identity creation in real compute. Every agent must mine a proof-of-work stamp before it can act, so spinning up a swarm costs energy per clone — a falcon's hunt repeated thousands of times. A single honest newcomer pays once; a sybil farm pays again for each fake, and that bill grows glacier-slow but relentless against the attacker. The stamp is a crystal-clear, ledger-anchored cost, not a promise anyone can fake.
